would like to give thanks and gratitude to all staff from the receptionist , nurses and doctors who have given me so much help, understanding and support for my mental health.

During my times of crisis which have been a result of trauma, addictions and mental health issues.

Whilst I have been demanding and desperate at times, the staff have always given great professional and emotional support.

I know that there are many others in this world who need help and support such as cancer patients, but people with severe mental health issues have their own kind of debilitating cancer, which at times prevents us from walking, breathing, eating, talking and other self care requirements, therefore mental illness is a disability.

Thank you so much for your continued help and support.

Kindest regards
Susan Case
